name: Deep Current
author: Trance
description: A different current every time: its directions and scales are rolled when it loads, the way G-Force rolls a FlowField's.
init:
a1 = 2 + rand(5)
a2 = 2 + rand(5)
a3 = rand(6.28)
a4 = 0.003 + rand(0.005)
a5 = rand(6.28)
drx = a4*cos(a5)
dry = a4*sin(a5)
pixel:
dx = drx + 0.004*sin(y*a1 + a3 + time*0.2)
dy = dry + 0.004*sin(x*a2 - a3 - time*0.17)
